phases.title: Prospective state / rollback / checkpoint contract
phases.scope: Freeze schema, digests, compatibility, failure semantics and gates; no production implementation.

phases.title: Checkpoint schema and state serialization foundation
phases.scope: Implement schema 2, accepted-state serialization, digest checks, topology validation and atomic persistence.

phases.title: Fixed/adaptive restart migration
phases.scope: Route fixed and supported adaptive continuation through one accepted-state checkpoint API and prove interrupted-run equivalence.

phases.title: Arc-length restart migration and compatibility
phases.scope: Persist accepted arc-length continuation state, preserve specialized correction mathematics and prove path equivalence.

phases.title: Independent closure audit
phases.scope: Adversarial audit of all gates, legacy authorities, corruption behavior and numerical preservation before any points are awarded.
